SELECT
	V.documentcode, 
	type = V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))), 
	date = V.date, 
	debit = V.Debit,
	credit= V.Credit,
	remark = V.Remarks,
	c.name,
	cash = case ISNULL(v.AlternateAccCode, -1) when -1 then 'N' else 'Y' end,
	c.aliasname,
	address=c.address1,
	openbalance=(select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate),
	c.areacode,
	c.area,
	V.CheckNo,
	V.VRow,
	V.vouchercode,
	C.Active,
	PendingCheque=0
FROM
	VirtualGL V,
	(SELECT	a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name, ct.address1, ct.areacode, area=ar.name, a.active
	FROM	accounts a, customer ct, area ar
	WHERE	ct.areacode IN (:ar_areacode) and 
		a.acccode = ct.custcode and ar.areacode=ct.areacode) C
WHERE 
	(V.AccCode = C.AccCode OR V.AlternateAccCode = C.AccCode ) and
	V.date     >= :ar_startdate and
	V.date     <= :ar_enddate
UNION ALL
SELECT
	V.documentcode, 
	type = V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))), 
	date = V.date, 
	debit = V.Credit,
	credit= V.Debit,
	remark = Case debit 
			When 0 then 'Cash Paid Against Sale Ret. # '
			Else 'Cash Received Against Sales Inv. # '
			End + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))),
	c.name,
	cash = case ISNULL(v.AlternateAccCode, -1) when -1 then 'N' else 'Y' end,
	c.aliasname,
	address=c.address1,
	openbalance=(select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate),
	c.areacode,
	c.area,
	V.CheckNo,
	V.VRow,
	V.vouchercode,
	C.Active,
	PendingCheque=0
FROM
	VirtualGL V,
	(SELECT	a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name, ct.address1, ct.areacode, area=ar.name, a.active
	FROM	accounts a, customer ct, area ar
	WHERE	ct.areacode IN (:ar_areacode) and 
		a.acccode = ct.custcode and ar.areacode=ct.areacode) C
WHERE
	(V.AlternateAccCode = C.AccCode ) and
	V.date     >= :ar_startdate and
	V.date     <= :ar_enddate
UNION ALL
SELECT
	documentcode = N.NoteCode, 
	Type = Case N.NoteCatCode When 1 Then '*NR' Else '*NP' End + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), N.NoteCode))),  
	date = N.duedate, 
	debit = Case N.NoteCatCode When 1 Then CASE WHEN N.AccCode = C.AccCode THEN 0 ELSE N.Amount END ELSE CASE WHEN N.AccCode = C.AccCode THEN N.Amount ELSE 0 END END,
	credit= Case N.NoteCatCode When 1 Then CASE WHEN N.AccCode = C.AccCode THEN N.Amount ELSE 0 END ELSE CASE WHEN N.AccCode = C.AccCode THEN 0 ELSE N.Amount END END,
	remark = N.Remarks,
	c.name,
	cash = 'N',
	c.aliasname,
	address=c.address1,
	openbalance=(select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate),
	c.areacode,
	c.area,
	CheckNo = LEFT(N.DocumentNumber, 20),
	VRow=999999,
	N.vouchercode,
	C.Active,
	PendingCheque=1
FROM 
	Notes N,
	(SELECT	a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name, ct.address1, ct.areacode, area=ar.name, a.active
	FROM	accounts a, customer ct, area ar
	WHERE	ct.areacode IN (:ar_areacode) and 
		a.acccode = ct.custcode and ar.areacode=ct.areacode) C
WHERE 
	(N.AccCode = C.AccCode OR N.BankAccCode = C.AccCode ) and
	N.Posted = 'N' AND N.Finalized = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT
	documentcode=0, 
	type = '', 
	date = :ar_enddate, 
	debit = 0,
	credit= 0,
	remark = '',
	c.name,
	cash = 'N',
	c.aliasname,
	address=c.address1,
	openbalance=(select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate),
	c.areacode,
	c.area,
	CheckNo='',
	VRow=0,
	vouchercode=Null,
	C.Active,
	PendingCheque=0
FROM
	(SELECT	a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name, ct.address1, ct.areacode, area=ar.name, a.active
	FROM	accounts a, customer ct, area ar
	WHERE	ct.areacode IN (:ar_areacode) and 
		a.acccode = ct.custcode and 
		ar.areacode=ct.areacode and
		a.acccode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT VGL.AccCode 
			FROM VirtualGL VGL 
			WHERE VGL.Date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
			UNION ALL
			SELECT DISTINCT N.AccCode 
			FROM Notes N
			WHERE N.Posted = 'N' AND N.Finalized='Y' AND
				N.DueDate BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
			UNION ALL
			SELECT DISTINCT N.BankAccCode 
			FROM Notes N
			WHERE N.Posted = 'N' AND N.Finalized='Y' AND
				N.DueDate BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate) AND
		a.acccode in 
			(select acccode 
			from virtualgl 
			where virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate
			group by acccode
			having isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) <> 0) ) C
ORDER BY 
	area, 
	name, 
	aliasname, 
	date, 
	type, 
	VRow
